summary: Larch Butte lookout, Clearwater NF: 30-foot L-4 tower built 1933, abandoned and gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned and gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes it as a hike-in.

events.note: 30-foot L-4 tower; all three lookout sources give 1933

evidence.supports: Location 13 miles ENE of Pierce, Clearwater County
Clearwater list entry: 30-foot L-4 tower, built 1933, abandoned
evidence.quote: Larch Butte Sec24 T37N 30’ L-4 1933 Abandoned 5539’
List compiled by Margaret Sand, Walde Lookout and Cindy Schacher, Archaeologist June 2016

notes_for_editor: Brief had no events; 1933 build added from three sources. No source dates the abandonment, so no abandoned event is recorded. Sources 1 and 3 both trace to Ray Kresek's book per the Forest Service list header, so they are not fully independent. Elevation: the three lookout sources give 5,539 ft; search snippets for the summit give 5,542 to 5,548 ft (not read in full), and the story uses the lookout figure. The brief coordinates (46.53931, -115.52759) look far east of Pierce for a 13-mile ENE distance by a rough check; verify the pin on a map before relying on it. Staffing: the Idaho page says none is documented, so nothing is written on staffing.
